## Calibration (every independent measurement found; FIT rows set a parameter, others are predictions)

```
source               quantity                                         meas    model   err%  note
DrAllurian 2021      farm adjacent TC, no techs                     36.800   36.810    0.0  FIT t_turn
DrAllurian 2021      farm adjacent TC + Wheelbarrow                 37.000   37.037    0.1  
DrAllurian 2021      farm diagonal (d=0.33), no techs               35.500   35.531    0.1  FIT d_diag
DrAllurian 2021      farm diagonal + Wheelbarrow                    36.000   36.275    0.8  
DrAllurian 2021      8 vills sheep under TC, no techs               40.000   39.387   -1.5  FIT t_sheep_group
DrAllurian 2021      8 vills sheep naive (d~2.6), no techs          33.000   30.218   -8.4  d from 'about a tile' path round TC, est
DrAllurian 2021      8 vills sheep naive + Wheelbarrow              40.000   33.683  -15.8  model under-predicts; noisy 3-min trial
DrAllurian 2021      Horticulture multiplier                         1.100    1.098   -0.2  
Sonnenbank 2021      sheep in place (d=0)                            0.750    0.733   -2.2  reads as raw rate; model is in-place effective
Sonnenbank 2021      berries in place (d=0)                          0.660    0.647   -1.9  reads as raw rate; model is in-place effective
Sonnenbank 2021      farm in place (d=0)                             0.625    0.613   -1.8  reads as raw rate; model is in-place effective
Sonnenbank 2021      deer in place (d=0)                             0.827    0.817   -1.2  reads as raw rate; model is in-place effective
forum 205270 2022    Wheelbarrow gain in place (d=0), %              2.500    0.739  -70.4  measured given as 2-3%
forum 205270 2022    Wheelbarrow gain walking (d=1), %               7.500    5.817  -22.4  measured given as 7-8%
forum 205270 2022    sheep 1 tile away, no WB, f/s (their arithmetic)    0.660    0.662    0.3  same formula, t_turn=0
formula check        TC 150 s base, 6 builders, s                   56.000   56.250    0.4  no measurement found; placeholder
```
Reading: in-place and near-drop-off predictions (farms, sheep under TC, Wheelbarrow on farms) land within 1%. The one mid-distance sheep case is 8-16% under the measured value: crowding and pathing of 8 villagers round a TC are not modelled and the trial was 3 minutes. The two Wheelbarrow rule-of-thumb rows are forum opinion, not measurements; the measured Wheelbarrow-on-farms row is the one to trust. No measurement newer than 2022 was found, so current absolute rates rest on the wiki table being current.
